Who Is Consuming Chinese Tokens?

Laila Khawaja

Gavekal Technologies: Chips | 29 Oct 2026

An unverified claim that over half of China’s domestic tokens are used for video and micro drama generation has sparked a heated online debate. Critics contrast China’s supposed use of scarce compute resources for entertainment with an alleged US focus on coding and productivity. The controversy took place as Chinese AI video models lead global rankings and as Chinese micro dramas and video generation applications rapidly expand their global influence. While the underlying data remain unconfirmed, the debate reveals the potential disconnect between Beijing’s ambitions for economy-wide AI transformation and the commercial realities of Chinese AI companies.
